## Plugin reference

- Description: Umbrella for the Mail app's providers — each a MailProvider behind the provider-neutral contract (mail/provider): Gmail first; IMAP, JMAP and Outlook later.
- Sub-plugins:
  - **`gmail`** [exempt] — Registers the Gmail mail provider: MailProvider over integrations/gmail/api, one client and quota pacer per account, Gmail's q compiled from the contract's filter.
